SUTR-0 — SUCS Core

The foundational layout of the Base SuperUnicode Character System.

This report defines the Base SUCS codepoint space, its hierarchy, its three spaces, and the reserved terminal region.

Space

SUCS_CP uint32_t, 31 significant bits
range 0x00000000 – 0x7FFFFFFF
hierarchy codepoint < block < range < plane < district < zone < territory

Spaces

Space Range Owner
Unicode Compatibility Space 0x000000–0x10FFFF 1:1 with Unicode, permanent
System Control Plane 0x110000–0x11FFFF BANcode Registry (B+, W+, C+, S+)
Native SuperUnicode Space 0x120000–0x7FFFFFFF OpenWindows allocations

Terminal region

  • Traps: 0x7FFFFFF0–0x7FFFFFFE
  • Sentinel: 0x7FFFFFFF
  • No allocation exists at or below the Sentinel.
